account.title: Account
account.description: Nova Poshta API tokens for a user

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this account entry

tokens.description: List of stored NP Accounts (name, token, selected)

updatedAt.description: Last updated timestamp in Firestore Timestamp format (or ISO string)

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.description: Subscription details for a user with WayForPay integration

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this subscription

status.description: Current status of the subscription (trial, active, expired, none)

trialStartDate.description: Start date of the 14-day trial (ISO string)

trialEndDate.description: End date of the 14-day trial (ISO string)

activeEndDate.description: End date of the active subscription period (ISO string)

wayforpayCardPan.description: Masked card number used for subscription

createdAt.description: Document creation timestamp in ISO format

updatedAt.description: Last updated timestamp in ISO format

userAccounts/{userId}.description: Stores user API tokens. The document ID is the userId.

userSubscriptions/{userId}.description: Stores user subscription information. The document ID is the userId.
